instructions.title: Review the Critical Power Alert
instructions.message: Review the active power warning on the Habitat status display.
instructions.guidance: Reserve power is approximately 20% as gameplay simulation unless a verified persisted value is available. Communication failure is independent.

instructions.title: Inspect the Engineering Power Unit
instructions.message: Review the existing Engineering Power Unit screens.
instructions.guidance: Record reserve, both panel states, main connection and distribution. These are simulated states unless a verified source is shown.

instructions.title: Diagnose Communication Failure
instructions.message: Review the existing Mission Control communication diagnostics.
instructions.guidance: Record external communications as offline. This diagnosis does not control the Power Failure warning or beep.

instructions.title: Prepare EVA
instructions.message: Use the existing Airlock EVA preparation interaction.
instructions.guidance: The shared suit and outdoor access rules remain authoritative.

instructions.title: Repair Solar Panel A
instructions.message: Travel to the existing Solar Panel A repair trigger.
instructions.guidance: Complete the interactive circuit repair with correct polarity and all required connections.

instructions.title: Repair Solar Panel B
instructions.message: Travel to the existing Solar Panel B repair trigger.
instructions.guidance: Complete the independent Panel B circuit repair. Panel A completion does not repair Panel B.

instructions.title: Repair the Main Solar Connection
instructions.message: Travel to the existing main solar connection repair trigger.
instructions.guidance: Route both repaired panel feeds through the main junction to the distribution bus.
instructions.activity: Validate the complete main power routing circuit.

instructions.title: Restore Main Power
instructions.message: Return to Engineering and use the existing Power Unit interface.
instructions.guidance: The interface verifies Panel A, Panel B and main connection records before enabling restoration. Communication remains offline.
instructions.activity: Confirm main supply restoration after all three repairs validate.

instructions.title: Verify Power Recovery
instructions.message: Verify restored supply and distribution in Engineering.
instructions.guidance: Confirm the power warning clears, the beep fades and configured lights restore. Keep the communication warning active.

instructions.title: Restore External Communication
instructions.message: Use the existing outdoor communication repair interaction after power recovery.
instructions.guidance: The communication repair is separate and must not restart the power warning beep.

instructions.title: Submit the Recovery Report
instructions.message: Return to Mission Control and submit the Sol 8 recovery report.
instructions.guidance: Report actual repairs, power and communication recovery independently, the Sol 7 post-storm reference, simulation provenance and remaining issues. Sol 9 does not start automatically.
instructions.activity: Validate and submit the final report.

completion.title: Sol 8 Recovery Complete
completion.message: Power and communication recovery are independently verified and recorded. Sol 9 has not been started.
